caption: Fig. 2.18  Possible exchange for a d⁵ configuration
note: text_layer was null; read from the image. One crop holds four stacked sub-figures, each a row of five boxed up-arrows (a d5 half-filled subshell) with red exchange arrows, plus one caption line each; all four belong to this single figure block, so their captions are listed as labels in top-to-bottom order. The bare numerals 1, 2, 3 and 4 are printed on the sub-figures themselves, marking which electron does the exchanging, and are listed immediately before the sub-figure caption they sit on. The occupancy number in the printed caption is a superscript on d; it is written here as the Unicode superscript character (d⁵) because the superscript is visible only in the image. Excluded as outside target_box_in_crop: the page number 65 and the panel's top border above the box, the bold section heading "Completely Filled and Half-filled Subshells", the left-hand column of body prose running down the page (only its right-hand word fragments are in the crop at all), and the panel's bottom border below the box.
